articles.title: Korea fines Baemin and Coupang Eats 631.9 billion won over pressure on restaurants
articles.easyKo: 공정위가 배달의민족과 쿠팡이츠에 합쳐 6,319억 원의 과징금을 물리겠다고 했어요. 식당에 '다른 앱보다 불리하지 않은 조건'을 내놓으라고 눌렀다는 이유예요. 아직 잠정 결정이고, 두 회사는 최종 결정문을 본 뒤 대응하겠다고 했어요.

paragraphs.en: South Korea's antitrust agency, the Fair Trade Commission (FTC), said on Monday that it will fine the two biggest food delivery apps. Woowa Brothers, which runs Baemin, will pay 331.1 billion won, and Coupang, which runs Coupang Eats, will pay 300.8 billion won. Together the fines come to 631.9 billion won, or about $467 million. The fines are provisional, so they are not yet final.
paragraphs.ko: 한국의 공정거래 당국인 공정거래위원회(FTC)는 월요일 가장 큰 배달앱 두 곳에 과징금을 물리겠다고 밝혔어요. 배달의민족을 운영하는 우아한형제들은 3,311억 원, 쿠팡이츠를 운영하는 쿠팡은 3,008억 원을 내게 돼요. 합치면 6,319억 원, 약 4억 6,700만 달러예요. 이 과징금은 잠정적이어서 아직 확정된 것은 아니에요.

sents.en: South Korea's antitrust agency, the Fair Trade Commission (FTC), said on Monday that it will fine the two biggest food delivery apps.
sents.ko: 한국의 공정거래 당국인 공정거래위원회(FTC)는 월요일 가장 큰 배달앱 두 곳에 과징금을 물리겠다고 밝혔어요.

sents.en: Woowa Brothers, which runs Baemin, will pay 331.1 billion won, and Coupang, which runs Coupang Eats, will pay 300.8 billion won.

sents.en: The fines are provisional, so they are not yet final.
sents.ko: 이 과징금은 잠정적이어서 아직 확정된 것은 아니에요.

paragraphs.en: The FTC says both firms used a rule called 'most favored nation.' Under this rule, restaurants had to give each app prices and terms that were no worse than those on rival apps. Restaurants that refused could lose a special status that gave delivery discounts to the app's members. Coupang used the rule from July 2023 to January 2026, and Baemin used it from May 2024 to October 2025.
paragraphs.ko: 공정위는 두 회사가 '최혜국 대우'라는 규칙을 썼다고 해요. 이 규칙 때문에 식당은 경쟁 앱보다 나쁘지 않은 가격과 조건을 각 앱에 내놓아야 했어요. 따르지 않는 식당은 앱 회원에게 배달 할인을 주는 특별 자격을 잃을 수 있었어요. 쿠팡은 2023년 7월부터 2026년 1월까지, 배민은 2024년 5월부터 2025년 10월까지 이 규칙을 썼어요.

paragraphs.en: Losing that status hurt restaurants badly. The FTC said daily sales at restaurants removed from Coupang's program fell from 220,000 won to 90,000 won on average. For restaurants removed from Baemin's program, daily sales fell from 110,000 won to 30,000 won. The agency said restaurants had little choice but to accept the terms. The share of restaurants with Coupang's Wow status rose from 13 percent in July 2023 to 94 percent in October 2025.

articles.easyKo: 세계 기후 회의 COP31이 튀르키예에서 열려요. 올해는 관측 사상 가장 더운 해가 될 가능성이 커서 분위기가 무거워요. 튀르키예는 전기 비중을 늘리자는 서약을 내놓았고, 일부 활동가는 화석연료에서 벗어날 분명한 계획이 더 필요하다고 말해요.

paragraphs.en: The United Nations climate summit, COP31, opens on Monday in Antalya, Turkey. Leaders from about 80 countries are expected to join the summit on Wednesday and Thursday. South Korea will send its climate ambassador, Kang Kum-sil, as a special envoy of the president. She plans to explain Korea's plans for electrification and for cutting carbon emissions.

paragraphs.en: Four students were caught using AI glasses to cheat on school exams this year, South Korea's education ministry said on Monday. The ministry collected data from all 5,679 middle and high schools in the country between Oct. 27 and last Tuesday. One middle school student and three high school students were caught during their midterm or final exams. The middle school and one high school are in Seoul, and the other two high schools are in North Jeolla Province and on Jeju.

A think tank is a research group that studies the economy and public policy.

paragraphs.en: Nvidia, SK Telecom and Korean chip startup Rebellions signed a deal on Monday. They agreed to build an AI computing system that mixes two kinds of chips. One kind is Nvidia's graphics processing units, or GPUs. The other is neural processing units, or NPUs, designed by Rebellions. SK Telecom will use the system in its AI data centers.
paragraphs.ko: 엔비디아, SK텔레콤, 한국 AI 반도체 스타트업 리벨리온이 월요일 합의서에 서명했어요. 이들은 두 종류의 반도체를 섞은 AI 컴퓨팅 시스템을 만들기로 했어요. 한 종류는 엔비디아의 그래픽처리장치, 곧 GPU예요. 다른 한 종류는 리벨리온이 설계한 신경망처리장치, 곧 NPU예요. SK텔레콤은 이 시스템을 자사 AI 데이터센터에 쓸 거예요.

paragraphs.en: Pope Leo XIV arrived in Argentina on Sunday, the second stop on a 12-day tour of Latin America. He is 71 and had surgery for lung cancer about three weeks ago. articles.title: Study: new hires quit sooner when given broad roles and lots of freedom
articles.easyKo: 한 연구에서, 여러 업무와 큰 결정권을 주는 회사는 경력 없는 신입을 첫해에 더 많이 잃었어요. 연구자는 숙련자에게는 자율이 도움이 되지만 초보자에게는 부담일 수 있다고 봤어요.

paragraphs.en: A new Korean study looked at why some new workers quit early. It found that companies giving workers many tasks and a big say in decisions lose more inexperienced hires in the first year. Turnover was lower at companies that value bonds and unity among employees.

sents.en: Turnover was lower at companies that value bonds and unity among employees.
sents.ko: 직원 사이의 유대와 단합을 중시하는 회사는 이직률이 더 낮았어요.

paragraphs.en: Nho Yong-jin, a business professor at Seoul National University of Science and Technology, presented the results at a conference last month. For beginners, though, the same things can make a job harder to understand or add to their burden.

articles.title: Korean banks plan bigger cybersecurity budgets after hacking cases
articles.easyKo: 해킹 사건이 이어지자 신한·하나·우리은행이 내년 정보보안 예산을 크게 늘리기로 했어요. 다만 이미 잡은 예산을 다 쓰지 못했고 보안 전담 인력도 적다는 지적이 함께 나왔어요.

paragraphs.en: Major Korean banks plan to spend much more on cybersecurity next year. Data released on Monday shows that Shinhan Bank will set aside 115 billion won in 2027. That is nearly 2.8 times its budget of 40.6 billion won this year. Hana Bank has set 100.1 billion won, and Woori Bank plans 76.3 billion won. KB Kookmin Bank is thinking about more than 100 billion won, but the amount is not final.
paragraphs.ko: 한국의 주요 은행들은 내년 사이버 보안에 훨씬 더 많은 돈을 쓸 계획이에요. 월요일 나온 자료를 보면 신한은행은 2027년에 1,150억 원을 책정할 거예요. 올해 예산 406억 원의 거의 2.8배예요. 하나은행은 1,001억 원, 우리은행은 763억 원을 잡았어요. KB국민은행은 1,000억 원이 넘는 금액을 생각 중인데, 아직 확정은 아니에요.
